cards.back: A number that names equal parts of a whole.
One complete object, shape or set.
Parts that are exactly the same size.
One equal part of a whole; the numerator is 1.
The top number: how many equal parts are counted.
The bottom number: how many equal parts are in one whole.
A line with numbers in order; a fraction is a point on it.
cards.example: 1/4 is one part from 0 when 0 to 1 is cut in 4

cards.back: The space between two numbers on a number line.

cards.front: What does the 4 in 3/4 tell you?
cards.back: The whole is cut into 4 equal parts.

cards.front: What does the 3 in 3/4 tell you?
A shape has 4 parts that are not equal. Is each part 1/4?
cards.back: No. Fourths must be equal parts.

cards.front: On a number line, do you count tick marks or spaces?
Where is 1/3 on a number line?
cards.back: Cut 0 to 1 into 3 equal parts. 1/3 is the end of the first part.
More. 4/4 is 1 whole, and 5/4 is one more fourth.
